ShortDescription.Value: Select existing roads, draw or paint an area, and fill it with streets in one click: 9 patterns from grids to winding suburbs, terrain-following streets and radial centres. 42 languages.

Publish.LongDescription:
# Grid Road Generator
Choose an area, pick a pattern, then press **Generate** to fill it with connected streets.
## Three ways to choose the area - **Existing perimeter** — click the nodes of roads that already surround the area (double-click a node to select the whole block). Streets join those roads. - **Draw area** — click points on the terrain, like the district tool; drag any point afterwards to reshape it. - **Paint area** — paint the area with a round or square brush from 1 to 1000 m (Shift + mouse to rotate the square), right-click to erase.
With a drawn or painted area, a smooth road is built along its edge. It connects to any existing road crossing the edge, and streets through water or buildings are left out.
## Nine patterns **Grid** — classic grid with columns, rows or fixed spacing, angle, cul-de-sacs with turnaround circles, and an avenue with a roundabout. *Align with the terrain* turns the grid so that half of the streets follow the contour lines.
**Tree** — a collector along the area with branches and pairs of cul-de-sacs.
**Organic** — a gently winding avenue with curved streets and cul-de-sacs, like a real suburb (curviness, loops and variation seed).
**Terrain** — streets that follow the contour lines, nearly level, linked by uphill streets never steeper than 15% (S-shaped on steep slopes). Flat parts get parallel streets.
**Mixed** — a radial centre surrounded by organic streets, joined by a ring road; the avenues of the centre carry on into the neighbourhood.
**Loop** — collector roads dividing the area into blocks, each served by an internal loop street.
**Superblock** — Barcelona-style zones separated by pedestrian streets.
**Concentric** — rings that copy the shape of the perimeter, with radial connections.
**Radial** — a central roundabout, avenues and rings; the roundabout can use its own road type.
## Networks, upgrades and zoning - Separate road types for streets, avenues, cul-de-sacs and the roundabout - Automatic upgrades: median trees or grass, roadside trees, bike lanes, wide sidewalks - **Automatic zoning**: pick a zone and it is painted along the new roads once they are built (empty cells only)
## Preview and tools - A line sketch that follows the terrain and updates live while you drag any slider - **Summary** above Generate: number of segments, length and estimated cost - **Undo / Redo** (Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y) for points, brush strokes and settings - Resizable panel: drag its left or right edge; two columns when wide, icons only when narrow - The real preview is validated like any road placement; if placement is blocked, it stays visible so you can see the conflict. Optional automatic removal of colliding pieces in **Options > Mods > Grid Road Generator**.
## Compatibility - **[Anarchy](https://mods.paradoxplaza.com/mods/74604/Windows)** by **yenyang** (optional): a toggle appears in the panel header, synced with Anarchy. No hard dependency.
## Keybindings (Options > Mods > Grid Road Generator) - **Ctrl+G**: toggle the tool · **Enter**: generate · **Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y**: undo / redo - **Right click**: remove the last point or node, or erase with the brush · **Escape**: clear the selection
## Languages **42 languages**: - **12 official game languages**: English, French, German, Spanish, Italian, Polish, Portuguese (Brazil), Russian, Japanese, Korean, Chinese (Simplified), Chinese (Traditional) - **30 community languages**, shown when a language mod adds them to the game (e.g. I18N Everywhere or a language pack): Portuguese (Portugal), Ukrainian, Thai, Vietnamese, Dutch, Arabic, Czech, Danish, Persian, Finnish, Filipino, Greek, Hindi, Croatian, Hungarian, Indonesian, Norwegian, Romanian, Swedish, Turkish, Catalan, Galician, Basque, Occitan, Welsh, West Frisian, Breton, Scots, Sardinian, Abkhaz
## Credits Node-selection, tooltip and UI architecture patterns adapted from [CS2-NetworkTools](https://github.com/lucarager/CS2-NetworkTools) by Luca Rager, under the MIT license. Thank you!
Publish.ChangeLog:
**0.4.1 - Smoother panel, Terrain continuity and right-to-left languages**
- The grid is now computed in the background: releasing a slider or changing the pattern no longer freezes the game; the previous sketch stays on screen until the new one is ready - Terrain pattern: streets keep their continuity; dead ends are joined to the street in front of them, and streets running close to each other are no longer cut into short pieces - Right-to-left layout: with the Arabic or Persian Localization mod, the panel and the network picker are mirrored to read from right to left
